entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This must be the entertainment hall,[n]just like we expected.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Then the slot-loving TV station[n]president should be here. Let[n]us search the area for him.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Our next target's in here. Let's get the[n]letter of introduction before we go[n]anywhere else.
